node.statement: Cross-product bounds: bilinearity of the original multiplication and the two-sided unit identities P_0 I_X=I_X P_0=P_0 give P_prime P_doubleprime=P_0(I_X-P_0)=P_0-P_0^2 and P_doubleprime P_prime=(I_X-P_0)P_0=P_0-P_0^2. Since node 1.1 gives ||P_0^2-P_0||<=delta=C_np*epsilon_X, norm symmetry under multiplication by -1 yields ||P_prime P_doubleprime||,||P_doubleprime P_prime||<=C_np*epsilon_X.
